label: Measured portal-tree scaffold with CCO completion and surface-artifact pruning

assumptions.method: fixed measured portal scaffold plus CCO growth from eligible measured terminal fronts
assumptions.constraints: measured scaffold fixed and unsplit; synthetic growth contained within liver surface and limited in connection length
assumptions.syntheticRadiusLaw: r_e = 0.18 mm * descendant_terminals^(1/2.7); exact Murray scaling at synthetic bifurcations
assumptions.surfaceTerminalPruning: Removed 215 generated terminal branches within 5.0 mm of the liver surface whose terminal approach had outward-direction cosine below 0.35; this targets surface-parallel or inward/backtracking artifacts while retaining outward-facing approaches.
